# Repository home for this research

The substantive theory and research live in `/Users/ren/theories`. Read that repository's `AGENTS.md`, `RESEARCH.md` and `_process/BRIEF.md` before continuing this work.

Use the existing repository study as the primary editing location. This dated workspace contains preserved historical work and delivery copies. Keep temporary scratch here only when useful; preserve unique substantive work in the repository before delivery and link Ren to repository files. Do not overwrite or relocate another active session's files.

# The research now lives in the repository

Continue from the [current research index](/Users/ren/theories/RESEARCH.md). It links the unified theory, concern studies, supporting-condition studies, proofs, reviews and experiments to their repository homes.

The `work/` and `outputs/` files here are historical or delivery copies. They have been audited against the repository; the [preservation manifest](/Users/ren/theories/sources/22-research-reconciliation-2026-10-05/MANIFEST.json) records the captured versions and their locations. Other sessions may have continued after that dated capture. Original files have not been removed.
